{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792981673540,"sessionID":"ses_e89f74624ffe4P73M53BAYCrOf","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"edit","callID":"toolu_01XfDWboaogrAKimJezWfDnA","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r2/matmul/matmul.cpp","oldString":"void initMatrix(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B, \n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                sum += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n            C[i * N + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n}","newString":"void initMatrix(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N) {\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Rows of C are distributed across threads; each row is owned by exactly one\n// thread, so there are no data races. For every C[i][j], the products are\n// accumulated in ascending k order, matching the original summation order.\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B, \n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    const double* a = A.data();\n    const double* b = B.data();\n    double* c = C.data();\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        double* crow = c + i * N;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            crow[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < N; kk += kBlock) {\n            const size_t kEnd = (kk + kBlock < N) ? kk + kBlock : N;\n            for (size_t k = kk; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n                const double aik = a[i * N + k];\n                const double* brow = b + k * N;\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    crow[j] += aik * brow[j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}"},"output":"Edit applied successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"diff":"Index: /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r2/matmul/matmul.cpp\n===================================================================\n--- /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r2/matmul/matmul.cpp\n+++ /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r2/matmul/matmul.cpp\n@@ -18,24 +18,40 @@\n     return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n }\n \n void initMatrix(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N) {\n+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n     for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n         for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n             mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n         }\n     }\n }\n \n+// Rows of C are distributed across threads; each row is owned by exactly one\n+// thread, so there are no data races.
